observations: Photo 0 is a professional catalog render or studio photograph, not a photo of the actual item in a local environment.
The image shows a modern oval center table with a white marble-patterned top.
The base is gold-toned, featuring one spherical leg and one C-shaped shelf support.
A matching side table and a TV console are visible in the background of the staged room.
There is a faint watermark or text overlay across the center of the image.

claims.evidence: The stock photo makes it impossible to distinguish between real marble, faux stone, or printed MDF.
Photo 0 is a marketing render, not a photo of the physical item the buyer would receive.

risks.risk: The actual item may be a lower-quality replica of the professional render shown.
risks.proof: A photo of the actual item in a warehouse or residential setting.

risks.risk: The 'marble' top may be a laminate or sticker on MDF rather than stone.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the edge and the underside of the tabletop.

risks.risk: The sale may exclude the matching side table shown in the photo.
risks.proof: A photo of the specific items included in the offer.

proof_requests: Photo of the actual table in its current location (not a catalog shot).
Close-up photo of the tabletop edge to verify material.
Photo of the underside of the table.
Clarification if the side table is included in the price.
response.reason: The seller is using a stock photo or digital render. I cannot value the item without seeing photos of the actual physical product to verify its existence, condition, and materials.
